chronology: F authoring sees training only until source seal; I may inspect current query without labels. Both then retire provider, run same frozen query-proposal and training-only-selection capabilities, independently admit source/recipe semantics, recompute all final state from training only. Both share T including mandatory two post-seal tools. No provider after source seal.
endpoint: Observed mapped positive-duration presses, event-assisted known-length retrospective complete batch. Not corrected/intended transcript, causal streaming, physiological causality or clinical deployment.
final_declaration: Each mode 468 sealed probability artifacts plus deterministic precommitted investigation.json; target-free row/entropy assertions, estimand and limitations, hidden conclusions deferred; no prose-quality metric.

input.arrays: Little-endian float32 C-order train [N,D+2], query [M,D]. Last train columns observed29class index and original N/(P*S_person*L_sentence) weight. Same-arm F/I/reference bytes identical. No zero-feature control.

feature_tags.EOG: actual full source names/types/order, D=25*C_EOG, no spatial positions, no invented channels
feature_tags.SHUFFLE: outer training NEURAL vectors permuted within private person/alias/session by retained original deterministic rule; labels/weights/query unchanged
feature_tags.TIMING: D=3, samples_per_key1, no channel geometry: positive key duration, previous within-sentence onset interval (first0), first indicator

input.final_model_context: FIT_CONTEXT.json present for final FIT and INFER. Copy exact object into returned MODEL.context, including original FIT phase, mode, source/recipe seals, support and case/arm/generation/modality.
input.layout: TRAIN_LAYOUT.json = {schema:neural066_train_layout_v1,sentences:[{id,person,session,template,begin,n_keys}]}; opaque grouping/order is case-local and matched across arms/modes/reference.

realms.diagnostic: same current-case training and query arrays; no query labels
realms.query: query.npy and queries[{id,begin,n_keys}]; no training data or labels
realms.train: train.npy and TRAIN_LAYOUT.json; no query values/lengths/targets

isolation: A/B public tool closure identical; reference/operator/author/private methods excluded by separately qualified source/image policy. /submitted and /model immutable; fresh output/scratch; no network or ambient provider. Host never imports submitted source.

model.arrays: map names -> {path,bytes,sha256,shape,dtype}; primitive C-order NPY, types <f4/<f8/<i8/|u1/|i1; no pickle or executable serialized state
model.custody: Own successful original FIT result seals exact MODEL. INFER uses read-only captured complete model and verifies exact pre/post identity. No preliminary or cross-case model.
model.stateless: literal bool; true requires empty arrays, semantic admission still required

predictions: Exact {format:typing_predictions_v1,task:NEURAL-066,generation,case,arm,sentences:[{id,p}]}; every query id once, n_keys×29 finite [0,1], sums within1e-6, no repair/truncation. No target in inputs.
provider_action: Exact {action,source:{entry,files},recipe,rationale}; source files complete UTF8 Python text, root entry; finite precommitted turns/tokens/bytes/shared preliminary tool T.
